name: JW Marriott Hotel Cairo
positioning: Resort-style hotel in New Cairo with a man-made beach and the Mirage City golf courses, near Cairo International Airport
best_for: Golfers who want courses right at the hotel
Families wanting a man-made beach, aqua park and kids club

facts.text: The hotel is in New Cairo, Egypt.
The hotel is located near Cairo International Airport and Al Manara International Conference Center.
Rooms have views of the golf course, resort pool or private beach, with deluxe marble bathrooms and soundproof windows.
The Royal Suite has a bathroom with a jacuzzi with golf views.
Mandara Spa covers 2,500 square meters and offers 30 treatments.
Younger guests can enjoy activities at the Kids Club with the Family by JW program.
The Executive Lounge offers a quiet library and office facilities.
JW Garden is the hotel's source of fresh ingredients.
Ahlein serves Lebanese cuisine with live Arabic music and belly dancing.

highlights.text: The hotel has a man-made beach with an aqua park designed for children.
Mirage City Golf Club, designed by architect Peter Harradine, has 27 holes on two courses, including an 18-hole, par-72 Championship Course.
Cabana rooms offer direct access to a pool.

considerations.text: The Grand Egyptian Museum is about 40 minutes from the hotel without traffic.
Executive Lounge access is restricted to guests 18 and older.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury international chains.
